offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures metal and plastic containers, closures and dispensing systems for food, beverage, personal care, household and pharmaceutical companies. Products are made in its own plants and sold directly to packaged-goods manufacturers, often under long-term supply contracts.

primary_products.value: metal food containers; metal aerosol containers; plastic containers; plastic and metal closures; dispensing systems

customer_segment.value: B2B: food, beverage, personal care, household and pharmaceutical product manufacturers

end_markets.value: food; beverage; personal care; household products; pharmaceutical; pet food

revenue_model.value: product sales: packaging containers and closures sold to customers, often under supply contracts

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: makes containers and closures from metal and plastic resin, sold to consumer goods brand owners

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, South America and Asia

specialization.value: related lines: metal containers, plastic containers, closures and dispensing systems sold to the same packaging customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling directly to packaged-goods manufacturers; own locations: company-operated manufacturing plants serving nearby customers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: food-contact safety rules from the FDA and environmental and workplace safety rules
